summary: MasterCraft Boat Holdings filed an 8-K supplementing its S-4/proxy statement for the pending acquisition of Marine Products Corporation via a two-step stock-and-cash merger. The deal, announced February 5, 2026, involves Merger Sub I merging into Marine Products, then Marine Products merging into Merger Sub II, with Marine Products becoming a wholly owned MasterCraft subsidiary. Two shareholder complaints (Jones and Morgan) were filed in New York Supreme Court alleging material omissions in the proxy statement, seeking to enjoin the merger. MasterCraft believes disclosures are adequate. Watch for potential settlement disclosures or court rulings on injunctive relief.
